name: aback-ui-monorepo
description: Aback UI: the npm packages (packages/*), the registry (registry/), and the abackui.com website (website/).

scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:registry && bun run build:cli && bun run --filter @aback-ui/website build
scripts.test: bun --filter @aback-ui/ui test && bun --filter aback-ui test && bun --filter @aback-ui/website test
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter aback-ui typecheck && bun --filter @aback-ui/ui typecheck && bun --filter @aback-ui/registry typecheck && bun --filter @aback-ui/website typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run check:registry && bun run test:consumer
